issue.title: test_epic_plan_modal_renders_no_raw_editor_for_capacity intermittently loses gate-singleton-0 during mount
issue.description:
Proposed by sase-1nn.8.4.3.5.1 note 2; triaged by its lander on 2026-10-25.

Full CI run 40138926091 attempt 2, Python 3.12 job 121024209959, at SHA 87827788c25c826b46e9c76f70b105a1ce624313 failed tests/ace/tui/test_notification_plan_gate.py::test_epic_plan_modal_renders_no_raw_editor_for_capacity with textual.css.query.NoMatches for #gate-singleton-0 during GateBranchControls.on_mount -> _refresh_submit_states -> _update_submit_state. The proposing note transposes the job ID to 121044209959; the retained log confirms 121024209959.

The phase reports isolated and full-file (17 passed) reruns on its unchanged tree, including repetitions, with no reproduction. The lander also ran this exact node serially twice on clean master 369ac34168; both passed (the retained repeat took 2.17s). Latest Full CI 40163212161 does not report this failure in any of its three Python legs. Known observed failure count is one; total historical trial count is unknown. Do not claim a quantified CI failure rate or a newly reproduced failure.

The test waits only for PlanApprovalModal to exist and then checks the absence of raw inputs; adjacent tests explicitly await the singleton button. The product queries those buttons from on_mount. Early test teardown while descendants mount is a hypothesis, not a proven root cause. Investigate that boundary and whether the product can receive mount work after teardown. Preserve strict absence assertions; fix semantic readiness or the actual lifecycle violation. Do not add sleeps, raised timeouts, retries, skips, or broad exception swallowing.

This is independent of the evidence-removal release epic (3d13864e76 only deletes archived files). Exact flake and all-type searches plus all last-week tasks found no duplicate. Active sase-j7 and its phase .4 concern process-global leakage; no leak evidence supports assigning this mount race there. Other missing-widget and finder tasks name different nodes and are not assumed to share a root. Size large: the cause remains unknown and requires investigation/planning.

task_type_fields.evidence: One recorded Full CI 3.12 failure, run 40138926091 attempt 2 job 121024209959 at 87827788c2. Proposing phase reports unchanged-tree isolated, repeated, and 17-test file passes. Lander observed two clean-master serial passes at 369ac34168; no fresh local failure. Exact historical denominator unknown; no reproduction in current Full CI 40163212161.

issue.creation_reason: Release integration phase proposed an unowned singleton mount flake; its landing audit confirmed the CI failure and serial passes, with no duplicate task or demonstrated active-epic cause.
